card.name: Nuclear and radioactive material text
card.fires_on: Words and digits inside nuclear-reactor or radiopharmaceutical passages, where the next word is likely radio-related, such as radioactive, radiation or isotope. This includes digits in years, isotope numbers and ICRP report numbers.

modes.label: Digits in numbers
modes.description: A digit within a year, isotope number or ICRP publication number in nuclear or radiology text.
modes.example: This reactor, nominally rated at 26 megawatts thermal, was put on line in early 1<<9>>64.

modes.label: Reactor wording
modes.description: Words in heavy-water reactor descriptions, such as thermal before megawatt.
modes.example: require about 0.75 tons of heavy water per<< thermal>> megawatt

modes.label: Radioactive material in patient text
modes.description: Punctuation or linking words, or the word radiation, in descriptions of injected radioactive material and handling.
modes.example: A very small amount of radioactive material is injected into a vein and travels through the bloodstream<<.>> The radioactive material collects in the bones

card.writes: It lowers the odds of radio-, radioactive and isotope words coming next.
card.plain: It marks spots in nuclear and radioactive-tracer text where a radiation word would otherwise be expected.
